events.description: The event will be followed by three rounds for the participants.
rules: Round 1: Group Discussion — this round tests leadership, communication, teamwork, listening ability, general awareness, and problem-solving skills.
Participants will be divided into groups and assigned a GD topic. Each group receives 10 minutes to discuss the topic; the most composed and articulate individuals qualify for the next round.
Round 2: Mock Interview — an HR interview assessing fitness for the corporate world through communication, perseverance, persuasion, and listening skills.
Round 3: Corporate Strategy and Risk Management — a critical corporate personnel-management scenario will be given, and the participant must explain their strategy within 10 minutes.
Evaluation is based on articulation, fluency, clarity of thought, creativity, presence of mind, practical applicability, and relevance of the solution.

events.description: Pitchers comprises an offline quiz based on the theme “Startups and Entrepreneurship” (qualifying in nature).
rules: Round 1: Offline quiz based on the theme ‘Startups and Entrepreneurship’ (qualifying in nature).
The quiz has 40 multiple-choice questions, with one or more than one correct answer.
There is no negative marking, and the qualifying score is 30%.
Round 2: Qualifiers present their startup idea using a PowerPoint presentation of no more than 10 slides, excluding cover and Thank You slides.
The presentation must address motivation for the idea, likelihood of success in the chosen industry, revenue-generation strategy, and marketing and finance strategy.
